selection_rules: Use primary or author-hosted sources wherever possible.
Avoid exact and substantive duplication with Registry reports R01-R11.
Select sources that expose mechanisms, variables, data, models, diagnostics, or aggregation logic.
Treat retrieval as byte capture only; semantic reverse engineering is performed by Codex close reading.
Do not activate a method merely because it appears in a source; reproduction and validation gates still apply.
